resources.string: Preview a short equipment test before starting it. Normal nights still need at least one hour. Test runs are kept for diagnostics and excluded from sleep history, sleep exports and Health Connect comparisons.
Start: 1 minute of %1$s at %2$s, fan 30%%.\nMiddle: 2 minutes of %1$s at %2$s, fan 30%%.\nWake: 2 minutes of %3$s at %4$s, fan 30%%.

This writes the test to the slot shown and starts the BedJet. The wake phase starts after about 3 minutes; the programme finishes after about 5 minutes. Phone alarms are not used. You can stop it with Off.
